✅ **Gate recommendation: approve.**

The observed-key union preserves later-row fields without adding wholly absent columns, so partial merge updates retain their existing semantics. Both added regressions pass, alongside local schema, empty-input, nested-value, and async ingestion checks.

[#4485](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/pull/4485) is an earlier open fix for the same issue that also routes blob rows through the shared conversion; coordinate which implementation lands.
